We need this sorted before month-end close.

Hello GCP billing team / partner ops,

We're writing on behalf of our customer Acme SaaS (invoice GCP-ACME-202703). A retroactive marketplace rate change created a negative line item that currently shows VAT applied. Per Acme's B2B EU status and our billing arrangement, this credit should be processed under reverse-charge (VAT not charged by marketplace).

Please confirm the following so we can complete your requirements:
1) Does GCP require the seller (Redwood Europe S.A.) or the buyer (Acme SaaS) to provide the VAT registration document to reissue the credit net-of-VAT?
2) Exact tax ID format you require for EU registrations (we can provide EU87654321 for Redwood Europe and EU12345678 for Acme).
3) If a signed amendment or credit acceptance form is needed, please share the template or DocuSign link.
4) Estimated SLA for issuing a corrected credit note and updated invoice.

Related references: HubSpot deal HUB-48392 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HUB-48392). We attached a suggested draft credit note in case that accelerates the process.

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

Thanks for the detailed note and attachments. We can reissue the credit but need the following to proceed:

1) Official VAT registration document for the buyer (Acme SaaS) to validate reverse-charge — the scanned VAT cert you attached is fine, but we also need the billing entity tax ID that will appear on the corrected credit note.
2) Confirmation of which entity should receive the credit: Redwood Europe S.A. (EU87654321) or Acme SaaS (EU12345678). Per marketplace policy credits are issued to the invoiced party; if Redwood should receive the credit we need a short letter from Acme authorizing assignment of credit to Redwood.
3) If credit is to be net-of-VAT (reverse-charge), please confirm in writing (one sentence via email is sufficient) so our billing team can apply the correct tax code.
4) Execute the attached DocuSign credit acceptance form for bookkeeping purposes.

Timeline: once items 1–4 are provided and validated, we expect to issue a corrected credit note within 7–10 business days. Note: if the credit needs to be transferred between entities we may require an additional 2–3 days for internal approvals.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/4f2a9c

- Requested that the corrected credit be issued to Redwood Europe S.A. (EU87654321) and that GCP apply the reverse-charge tax code. GCP asked for a short email from Acme authorizing credit assignment if the credit is to be directed to Redwood.

Could you please reply to this thread with one line: “Acme SaaS authorizes the credit for invoice GCP-ACME-202703 to be assigned to Redwood Europe S.A. (VAT EU87654321).” That will satisfy GCP.
